name: Can I stay in my home while interior remodeling is taking place?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home while interior remodeling is taking place?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can remain in your home depends primarily on the scope and location of the remodeling work. If the project is limited to a single guest bathroom or a basement remodel, homeowners can usually stay in the house comfortably. However, for whole-house renovations, major open-concept floor plan reconfigurations, or simultaneous kitchen and bathroom overhauls, living on-site becomes challenging due to noise, dust, and disruptions to plumbing and power. A key decision factor is daily lifestyle: homes undergoing complete interior updates often lack working cooking or bathing facilities, making temporary off-site lodging more practical and less stressful.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can often stay for single-room updates, but full-home remodels with kitchen and bath shutdowns usually require temporary lodging.
